g.text: Held-out prediction accuracy · higher is better

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #50545b

g.text: Arithmetic means: equal directions for cross-panel; equal families within each trait for LOFO; then equal traits. No pooled correlations.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #50545b

g.text: Error bars: pointwise 95% cluster-bootstrap intervals, conditional on fitted models. Reference-line intervals remain in Parquet.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #50545b

g.text: NAM: family blocks. Ames: parent blocks within tester-pattern strata. Residual kinship and training uncertainty are not covered. Single shuffle held fixed.
